title: The Battle for Fort Snowhawk (Imperial)
description: Legate Rikke orders the player to join Imperial soldiers in an assault on Fort Snowhawk, a Stormcloak-held fort in Hjaalmarch. The player must rendezvous with the assault force and help clear the fort of rebels to secure it for the Empire.

base_facts: I am Legate Rikke, commanding Imperial forces in Hjaalmarch from the Imperial Camp.
I report to General Tullius on the progress of the war in Skyrim.

REPORT_FOR_DUTY: I gave orders to assist in taking Fort Snowhawk from the Stormcloaks.
FORT_SNOWHAWK_TAKEN: Fort Snowhawk has fallen to Imperial forces. Hjaalmarch is secured for the Empire.

base_facts: I am General Tullius, commander of the Imperial Legion in Skyrim.

REPORT_FOR_DUTY: I directed the soldier to Legate Rikke for the assault on Fort Snowhawk.
FORT_SNOWHAWK_TAKEN: The capture of Fort Snowhawk brings us closer to reuniting Skyrim under Imperial rule.

beats.comment: Player reports to Legate Rikke at Hjaalmarch Imperial Camp and receives orders to assault Fort Snowhawk.
Player reaches Fort Snowhawk and joins the Imperial soldiers preparing the attack.
Fort Snowhawk is cleared of Stormcloak rebels and secured for the Empire. Idgrod Ravencrone is re-instated as Jarl.
